summary: Fixed the flawed design document by resolving all 3 critical gaps: genuine alternatives, hidden assumptions surfaced as open questions, and concrete 5-question risk mitigation.
evidence: Added 3 genuine alternatives to Kafka (Managed Cloud Queue, In-Process Worker Queue, Scheduled Batch Processing) with balanced pros and cons.
Surfaced the database 10k writes/sec benchmark assumption as an explicit Open Question with a concrete staging load test validation plan.
Replaced vague 'monitor closely' mitigation with an actionable 5-part plan (Datadog metric, 10k lag threshold, scaling script command, on-call SRE owner, 15m resolution SLA).
Included the risk of doing nothing.
